details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- tests/test_review_rb_judge_label_propagation.py:789-790 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The test sets MERGE_COMPLETION_POLL_ATTEMPTS and MERGE_COMPLETION_POLL_SLEEP, but the script under test never reads those variables.
  WHY: The env vars have no runtime effect and make the test appear to control polling behavior that the script does not implement.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:950-959 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The check-runs gate fetches only the first 100 check-runs with no pagination.
  WHY: A commit with more than 100 check-runs can hide pending or failing runs on later pages, so the gate can report success against incompletely validated code.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:247 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: _pr_checks_completed falls back with || echo "" instead of the JSON fallback used by the standalone script.
  WHY: The empty-string fallback is inconsistent with the other implementation and can produce jq parse errors if that path is hit.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:247 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The check-runs gate fetches only the first 100 check-runs with no pagination.
  WHY: A commit with more than 100 check-runs can hide pending or failing runs on later pages, so the gate can report success against incompletely validated code.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:251-256 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The gate marks every closed PR as SHOULD_RUN=false, including merged PRs.
  WHY: GitHub reports merged PRs as state=closed, so the merged-PR recovery flow cannot reach the judge job.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:2167,2311,4085 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: force_rb_judge does not bypass the PR_CLOSED gate.
  WHY: Even when forced, the workflow still skips the judge step for closed/merged PRs, so the intended recovery path is unreachable.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:937-996 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The merge_with_followup refusal branches do not consistently emit structured skip outputs.
  WHY: Most refusal paths only log warnings, so downstream consumers cannot reliably classify why the judge declined to proceed.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:10130-10131 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The orchestrator refusal path does not send the Telegram notification that the acceptance path uses.
  WHY: Operators relying on tg_notify will not be alerted when merge_with_followup is refused.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:633,636,683,799 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The PR state validation still accepts the unreachable state value merged.
  WHY: GitHub REST returns open or closed, so allowing merged is dead code that misleads maintainers about the API shape.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:893 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: PR_MERGED silently defaults to false when the JSON/JQ pipeline fails.
  WHY: A malformed or transient API response can hide an already-merged PR and send the script down the wrong control path.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:939-940 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The synchronous-merge path treats a successful gh pr merge as proof that all required checks were satisfied.
  WHY: Merge queues or informational checks can still permit a merge/queue action here, so MERGE_CONFIRMED=true can be set before validation is actually complete.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:554-557 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The guard re-fetch can still leave PR_ALREADY_MERGED stale/false after auto-merge lands mid-run.
  WHY: If the refreshed JSON is malformed or the jq path fails, later logic can proceed as though the PR were still unmerged.
- tests/test_review_rb_judge_label_propagation.py:663 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The test uses list[str], which requires Python 3.9+.
  WHY: On older Python versions this annotation would be a SyntaxError and the test file would not load.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- tests/test_review_rb_judge_label_propagation.py:789-790 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The test harness sets MERGE_COMPLETION_POLL_ATTEMPTS and MERGE_COMPLETION_POLL_SLEEP env vars, but the standalone review_rb_judge.sh never reads these identifiers.
  WHY: The env vars have no runtime effect and can mislead readers into thinking the test controls a merge-completion phase that does not exist.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:247 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The _pr_checks_completed function uses || echo "" as a fallback for the check-runs JSON fetch, while the standalone review_rb_judge.sh uses || echo {}.
  WHY: The empty-string fallback is inconsistent with the standalone pattern and can cause jq parse errors if it is ever reached.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:952, and scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:247 | severity=medium | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: Both check-runs gates fetch ?per_page=100 without pagination.
  WHY: Commits with more than 100 check-runs can hide pending or failing runs on later pages, so the gate can miss incomplete validation.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
- tests/test_review_rb_judge_label_propagation.py:789-790 | severity=low | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The test sets MERGE_COMPLETION_POLL_ATTEMPTS and MERGE_COMPLETION_POLL_SLEEP environment variables, but the actual script only uses PR_MERGEABLE_POLL_ATTEMPTS and PR_MERGEABLE_POLL_SLEEP.
  WHY: These env vars have no runtime effect and misstate the behavior the test is exercising.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:952 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The check-runs gate uses ?per_page=100 with no pagination.
  WHY: A commit with more than 100 check-runs can hide pending or failing checks beyond the first page and allow merge_with_followup to proceed against incompletely validated code.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:937-996 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The merge_with_followup branch has several refusal paths that do not emit structured judge_action=skip and judge_skip_reason outputs.
  WHY: Downstream consumers cannot consistently classify refusal reasons when most refusal branches only log warnings.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:251-256 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The gate sets SHOULD_RUN="false" for all closed PRs, including merged PRs.
  WHY: Merged PRs are reported as state=closed by GitHub, so the post-merge recovery flow cannot reach the judge job.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:2167,2311,4085 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: force_rb_judge=true does not bypass the PR_CLOSED gate.
  WHY: Even when forced, the judge step still gets skipped for closed or merged PRs, making the forced recovery path ineffective.

  PROBLEM: The orchestrator refusal path for missing follow-up details does not send the Telegram notification used by the acceptance path.
  WHY: Operators relying on tg_notify will not be alerted when merge_with_followup is refused.

=== FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_1-fast ===
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:952-959 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The check-runs gate uses fixed per_page=100 with no pagination.
  WHY: If a PR head has more than 100 check-runs, later pages can contain pending or failing runs that the gate never sees.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:10146 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The _pr_checks_completed helper also fetches check-runs with per_page=100 and no pagination.
  WHY: The orchestrator can overlook pending or failing check-runs beyond the first page and advance merge_with_followup incorrectly.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:251-256 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The retrigger gate skips codex-agent for any closed PR, including merged PRs.
  WHY: Merged PRs are state=closed, so the standalone post-merge recovery path never runs.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:2167,2311,4085 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: force_rb_judge=true still hits the downstream PR_CLOSED=true gate.
  WHY: The explicit force path is supposed to bypass normal flow controls, but the judge step still gets skipped for merged PRs.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:939-940 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The synchronous-merge path assumes gh pr merge returning 0 means the merge actually landed with all required checks satisfied.
  WHY: Merge queues or informational checks can break that assumption and cause MERGE_CONFIRMED=true to be set too early.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:633,636,683,799 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Multiple PR state checks still validate against the unreachable value merged.
  WHY: GitHub REST never returns state=merged, so the accepted value is dead code that can mislead maintainers.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:554-557 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The guard re-fetch can leave PR_ALREADY_MERGED stale false after auto-merge lands during the judge run.
  WHY: If the refresh or jq path fails, the script can proceed with unsafe assumptions about the PR still being unmerged.
- tests/test_review_rb_judge_label_propagation.py:663 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The test uses list[str], which requires Python 3.9+.
  WHY: Older Python versions would fail to parse the file, preventing the test suite from loading.
